name: LumenRadio AB (publ)
summary: LumenRadio AB (publ) is a technology firm that specializes in crafting and distributing wireless communication solutions for highly critical Internet of Things applications, facilitating seamless device-to-device connectivity. Their comprehensive portfolio encompasses finished products for end-users, compact radio modules, and integrated software packages. These offerings support various wireless communication protocols such as DMX, DALI, Modbus, Mesh, and BACnet. The company's solutions find extensive use across diverse sectors including entertainment and smart lighting, HVAC systems, broader building automation, and industrial IoT environments. Established in 2008, LumenRadio AB (publ) operates from its main office situated in Gothenburg, Sweden.
